info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Linarite Syrup Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Linarite Syrup Catalog Management API enables businesses to efficiently manage product details for Linarite syrup offerings. Through this endpoint, users can submit and update detailed information about Linarite syrup, including ingredients, packaging, and pricing. This API is essential for retailers and manufacturers looking to maintain accurate and up-to-date product catalogs to enhance customer experience and facilitate informed purchasing decisions. Typical consumers include e-commerce platforms, supply chain managers, and marketing teams focused on product management.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create new details for the Linarite syrup product. It accepts the necessary information in the request body to successfully add the details to the database.

requestBody.description: Provides the necessary details for creating a new Linarite syrup entry. The request body must adhere to the specified schema, which includes all required fields and their types.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the details of the linarite syrup.

CreateCatalogLinariteSyrupDetailRequest.title: Linarite Syrup Request Body

linarite_syrup_id.description: The unique identifier for the Linarite Syrup.

requestedBy.description: The name of the individual or entity requesting the Linarite Syrup.

quantity.description: The quantity of Linarite Syrup being requested.

isPriority.description: A flag indicating whether the request should be treated as a priority.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of Linarite Syrup.

tags.description: A list of tags associated with the Linarite Syrup request for categorization.

items.description: A tag for the Linarite Syrup request.

CreateCatalogLinariteSyrupDetailRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for creating a new Linarite Syrup entry in the system. It includes details like the ID, requester, quantity, priority, and pricing.
